caption: The drawing consists of two outlined representations of the same short-sleeved dress on a blank background. The main, larger dress is situated in the center foreground and is filled with a repeating floral pattern of small red and pink flowers with green leaves on an off-white base color. The dress has a gathered or ruched neckline, a fitted waist with a seam or waistband, and a flared skirt that extends outward. The smaller, secondary outline in the upper right corner shows the dress from the back; this view is not filled with color or pattern, only the outline is present. Both dress forms are headless and limbless, illustrated with simple neck stubs to provide context for how the dress would be worn. The drawing uses black lines to delineate the shapes and features of the dress. The background is a plain, light beige color. There is a handwritten signature in the bottom right corner.
title: Child's Dress
